solutions.title: Row and column marker sets
solutions.strategy: Record every row and column containing a zero, then rewrite cells whose row or column was recorded.

timeComplexity.explanation: Both the scan and rewrite visit each cell.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The marker sets can store every row and column.

solutions.title: First row and column markers
solutions.strategy: Use the first row and column as marker storage, with flags for whether those marker areas originally contained zeroes.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell is inspected and possibly rewritten a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two boolean flags and loop variables are stored.
